effects: Pulls exactly `amount` of the vault collateral (SWELL, 0x0a6E…5676, set in the proxy's init data) from the signer to the vault via safeTransferFrom, which uses the signer's existing allowance.
Mints active vault shares (previewDeposit of the received amount) and credits them to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily the signer; this stake then becomes slashable.
Reverts if onBehalfOf is zero, if the signer is not whitelisted while the whitelist is on, or if the deposit limit would be exceeded. Not payable.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 SWELL for the beneficiary address, with fields for the vault, the SWELL amount and the beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown; it comes from vault storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` depends on activeShares/activeStake in storage; the descriptor shows only #.amount and #.onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor; the share price is not in the calldata.

effects: Burns the signer's active shares, previewWithdraw(amount) rounded up; reverts if that is more than the signer holds.
Moves exactly `amount` SWELL of stake from active stake into the withdrawal queue of the next epoch (currentEpoch+1). No tokens move in this transaction.
Credits withdrawal shares for that epoch to `claimer`. Only the claimer can claim them later, after that epoch ends (7-day epochs). The queued amount stays slashable until then.
formats.shown: Request 2.5 SWELL withdrawal for the claim owner, with fields for the vault, the requested SWELL amount and the claim owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned, the claim delay and the slashing exposure of the queued amount are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw/_withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` and `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1;` plus onSlash reducing `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]`; all come from storage, not calldata.
findings.fix: None needed in fields. The intent already says 'Request'. A label like 'Requested assets (claimable after next epoch)' is optional.

effects: Burns exactly `shares` of the signer's active vault shares; reverts if the signer holds fewer.
Converts them to SWELL at the current share price (previewRedeem) and queues that amount for the next epoch.
Credits withdrawal shares for that epoch to `claimer`, who alone can claim the SWELL after the epoch ends. No tokens move now.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for the claim owner, with fields for the vault, the raw share count and the claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: shares are shown as a raw 18-decimal integer, but a unit format could render them readably.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` format `raw` gives '987654321123456789' in case 2. ERC4626Math `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares use the same 18-decimal scale as SWELL.
findings.fix: Use format `unit` with params {"base":"shares","decimals":18} for #.shares (displays ~0.9877 shares).

findings.title: redeem: the SWELL amount the shares queue is not shown; it depends on the vault's share price.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares());` reads storage.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed. Reverts if the epoch has not ended, was already claimed or is empty.
Transfers the signer's whole withdrawal for that epoch, withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender), in SWELL from the vault to `recipient`, who may be someone other than the signer.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient, with fields for the vault, the raw epoch number and the recipient.

findings.title: claim: no part of the screen names the asset paid out (SWELL).
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` collateral is SWELL (init data, metadata.constants.underlyingToken). The descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}' do not mention the token.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, for example 'Claim SWELL withdrawal' and 'Claim SWELL from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the SWELL amount sent to the recipient is not shown; it comes from vault storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender);` computed from withdrawalSharesOf/withdrawals/withdrawalShares in storage.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed. Reverts if any epoch has not ended, was already claimed or is empty, or if the list is empty.
Transfers the sum of the signer's withdrawals for those epochs, in SWELL, from the vault to `recipient` in a single transfer.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42 and 44 and 128 to the recipient, with one Epoch field per epoch and a Recipient field.

findings.title: claimBatch: no part of the screen names the asset paid out (SWELL).
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` The descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals' and 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}' do not name the token.
findings.fix: Use 'Claim SWELL withdrawals' and 'Claim SWELL from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total SWELL sent to the recipient is not shown; it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);` where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender) from storage.
